overview: Installs common operations tools on a Himosoft server — base packages (curl, jq, gnupg) and optionally Helm 3. Every install step asks for confirmation before proceeding.
prerequisites: Debian or Ubuntu with this mirror configured

steps.title: Install the package
steps.command: sudo apt update && sudo apt install himosoft-server-deps

steps.title: Run interactive install
steps.body: Confirms each group of packages before installing.

commands.description: Interactive install of ops packages and optional Helm 3

notes: Base packages: curl, jq, ca-certificates, gnupg, apt-transport-https
Helm 3 is optional — you will be prompted
Recommended on Server A before running himosoft-k3s-server
